Definition: Jerubbesheth, a symbolic name for Gideon
BiblicalUsage: Jerubbesheth is another name for Gideon, used where the writer will not repeat the name of Baal. In 2 Samuel 11:21, Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerubbesheth matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
